condition: Frozen validation-selected checkpoints on one common64-training-layout reference and100 held-out validation/test layouts. One complete goal, all legal successors, no search or history mask. Fixed distance-bin allocation is independent of model predictions. Native v2 outputs are preserved separately and not used for cross-layout-count seen-layout claims.

coverage64.ranking_coverage_scope: Allowed complete goals and held-out closure for the ranking sources selected in this run; sampled source banks do not imply coverage of every physical state.
coverage64.initial_row_label_comparison: Initial labels belong to the saved source-row placeholder goals used by the baseline strata, not necessarily to the online-resampled actual goal. These transition counts quantify that mismatch without inferring which source draws came from the broad branch.
coverage64.note: Each CSV row is one saved actual optimizer batch. Repeated steps across attempts are retained explicitly. No historical per-step gradient was recorded or reconstructed here.

coverage1000.ranking_coverage_scope: Allowed complete goals and held-out closure for the ranking sources selected in this run; sampled source banks do not imply coverage of every physical state.
coverage1000.initial_row_label_comparison: Initial labels belong to the saved source-row placeholder goals used by the baseline strata, not necessarily to the online-resampled actual goal. These transition counts quantify that mismatch without inferring which source draws came from the broad branch.
coverage1000.note: Each CSV row is one saved actual optimizer batch. Repeated steps across attempts are retained explicitly. No historical per-step gradient was recorded or reconstructed here.

source_bank_overlap.scope: Static source-bank membership. Counts are unique prepared ranking source rows and their legal candidate occurrences, not actual optimizer-batch weights. Point regression only uses the selected point-source bank; ranking can encode additional states. This does not establish a causal explanation of failure.
